svg.title: Three computation-specific representations of one wooden crate
svg.desc: Three consistently framed renders of the supplied A23DMOD USD wooden crate. The visual surface uses the four supplied 2K texture maps. The collision view is a deterministic triangulated proxy derived from the mesh. The physical view uses the same geometry as a uniform-density analytical mass model. An orange bracket identifies a support-contact query region. All render backgrounds are transparent.
svg.text: One authored mesh · three computation-specific representations
A23DMOD USD SOURCE · FIXED CAMERA · AUTHORED SCALE

g.text: Density model gives mass · centre · inertia

svg.text: Each representation retains the source frame and answers a different computation.
